B: B_φ(y) = t(α⁻¹(φ, y)) is a bijection Y_x → Y_{x'}; c_φ(g) = φ ∘ (g ∘ φ⁻¹) is a bijection G_x → G_{x'} preserving units and composition; B_φ is equivariant; and (g, y) ↦ (c_φ g, B_φ y) is a bijection G_x × Y_x → G_{x'} × Y_{x'}. B reads (11.16) and φ̃ as the project does.
